Specialization.Name: Advocate (reSpecialized) 1.01
Specialization.Description: [H4]Advocate (reSpecialized)[h4] [B]ADVOCATE—PITHY DESCRIPTION[b][BR] [B]At a Glance[b][BR] The Advocate is a phenomenal social combat-oriented character, operating as the party support, or a take-down artist in equal measure.[BR] [B]All-in or Hybrid?[b][BR] ½ Buffing Mentor-oriented character ¼ Cunning Social Manipulator ¼ Vicious Social Duelist.[BR] [B]What Should it be the Best At?[b][BR] Social Support[BR] Social Dueling, Especially Defense as Offensive[BR] [B]What should it be just “good” at?[b][BR] Being Charming[BR] Negotiation[BR] [B]Specs for Comparison / Inspiration[b][BR] [I]Politico[i](Any social character that cares about more than one social skill will start to look pretty similar. The Politico is kind of a self-contained mover and shaker, whereas the Advocate is more of “side-kick” in social settings, though grossly powerful otherwise)[BR] [I]Makashi Duelist[i](The focus on turning flubbed attacks into powerful turnabout is a pretty similar thing to Makashi dueling. A great social defense makes for a solid social offense). Prophet (The prophet is closer to the Politico, making it a solid primary social character, but with a forcey lean. It does end up being a serious force multiplier with some of its talents, and it does have Twisted Words.)[BR] [I]Advisor[i](Unfortunately, the Advisor is pretty bleh pile of stuff, but the skills and vibes are pretty similar)[BR] [B]Media Touchstones[b][BR] Mas Amedda (Episode 1: The Phantom Menace) Nute Gunray (Episode 1: The Phantom Menace) Donnel Udina (Mass Effect) Miles Edgeworth (Ace Attorney)[BR]
